---
title: Sun levels
---

Light app levels are sun elevation: degrees above the horizon, for your location.

| Level | Name | Outdoors |
|---|---|---|
| `6` | Low sun | About an hour from the horizon |
| `0` | Sunrise, sunset | Sun on the horizon |
| `-6` | Civil dawn, civil dusk | Light enough to see |
| `-12` | Nautical dawn, nautical dusk | Dark; horizon visible |
| `-18` | Astronomical dawn, astronomical dusk | Fully dark |

## Settings

| Setting | Sunrise apps | Sunset apps |
|---|---|---|
| `from_level` | Light on. Below the horizon. | Light on. Above the horizon. |
| `to_level` | Full brightness. Higher than `from_level`. | Full brightness. Lower than `from_level`. |
| `off_level` | Light off. Higher than `to_level`. | Light off. Lower than `to_level`. |

- Set `to_level` above `from_level` to fade as the sun rises, below to fade as it sets.
- `from_level` and `to_level` must differ.

## Seasons

- Levels follow the sun. Leave them alone when the seasons change.
- Near the poles the sun may not reach a level some days. The fade does nothing those days.

## Picking levels

| Want | Change |
|---|---|
| Sunset light on earlier | Raise `from_level` |
| Sunrise light on earlier | Lower `from_level` |
| Full brightness sooner | Move `to_level` toward `from_level` |
| Slower fade | Move them apart |
| Off sooner after sunrise | Lower `off_level` |
